g.text: A conditional function survives 32 damaged rebuilds
E041 | 512 lineages in 32 independent blocks | original reported estimates
Every renewing body loses 24 cells. Fresh terminal readers also receive a scattered 24-cell injury.
Intervals are the saved pointwise 95% block-bootstrap estimates. Task and reconstruction machinery are supplied.
